The Judgment And Award Dated: 14.06.2018 Passed
In Mvc No.1275/2017 On The File Of The Principal
Senior Civil Judge And M.A.C.T, Belthangady,
Dismissing The Claim Petition For Compensation.
 This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Tara Vitasta Ganju
 Oral Judgment
1.
This Court by its order dated 20.08.2025 after being informed that the counsel for the appellants is no more had issued court notice to the appellants.

On 08.01.2026, this Court had observed that the appellants had been NC: 2026:KHC:6442 HC-KAR served, however none had been appeared,
and to afford one more opportunity, the matter was listed today.
2. There is no presence on behalf of the appellants today as well.
3. The appeal is accordingly dismissed in default and for non-prosecution.
